validator: independent validator subagent (Claude Opus 5.5), not the session that produced E30; this recompute is its own standard-library Rust program (validate_e30.rs: JSON parser, SHA-256 and leaf comparator taken from the E27 validator's validate_e27.rs, the rest new) and shares no code with examples/e30_audit.rs, examples/e30_tables.rs, crypto_lib or experiments/35_invariants_lite/summary.json
row: E30 (GLV note §9.28 pre-registration, §9.32 results): invariants-lite, an accounting audit of trivial F_p4 products on E27's 20 Karatsuba solver-A rows (E25's ten GLS curves, both arms) and the matched <±psi> walks. Class: accounting. Evidence directory research/e30_invariants_lite_20261030
status_rule: pass iff every check holds and every headline agrees with its printed figure within half a unit of the last printed digit (exact for counts)

checks.check: G2.110: every field of E27's 20 Karatsuba records reproduced by E30's audited records (leaf by leaf, 10 files x 2 arms); the only new leaf is ic_trivial_product_savings; wall_ms and solve_ms not compared
Every audited arm (20) solved and correct, its logarithm equal to the walks' (E25's planted d, as E27's validation), and all 48 in-process walks per arm correct with the same d

E30's walk audit (binary 0e4fccce1, serial Karatsuba walks) reproduces E27's walk (ii) means exactly on all 20 (curve, fold) pools: the 0e4fccce1 build walks the same walks at the same price as af2504ef1
The <±psi> walks' psi multipliers (c_x, c_y) are not in F_p on any of the ten curves (so the audit has nothing to re-price in psi)

Audit scope (validator's own bound): the counter is reset after set-up, so trivial products in precompute, base construction and the [x]G check are not audited; those phases are at most this share of S, which bounds what the audit can have missed

Note's "F_p4 work ≈ 2 % of S, about one in seven of its counted products trivial": the F_p4-priced phases (Weil restriction + target generation + lift) are this share of S, and the saving is this share of their multiplications; product counts are not emitted, so "one in seven products" is not checkable from the records (a trivial product saves 9 or 13 of 13)
checks.detail: F_p4 phases 1.531-1.896 % of S; saving 0.164-0.202 of their multiplications

e30_against_e27.schema: e30-vs-e27/v1 (a = E27's Karatsuba record, b = E30's audited record)
e30_against_e27.rule: every leaf of a against b: integers and floats by their text (equal text, or equal value with the same integer/float form; integers compared exactly as i128), strings and booleans exactly; wall_ms and solve_ms are wall-clock and listed, not compared

gae_band.definition: IC: audited S = total_muls - ic_trivial_product_savings, + w * 97 * macaulay_entries; rho: E27's <±psi> walk (iii) mean - the walk audit's mean saving, + w * 97 * mean steps; GAE = 97 F_p multiplications (E25's affine addition), as E27's validation

verdicts_recomputed.recomputed: E30 = E27 on 12100 of 12100 compared leaves; the only extra leaf is the audit counter

errata.claim: §9.32: "which here is ≈ 2 % of S, so about one in seven of its counted products is trivial"
errata.recomputed: the F_p4-priced phases are 1.53-1.90 % of S and the saving is 0.164-0.202 of their multiplications; the product count is not emitted, so "one in seven products" cannot be checked from the records
errata.effect: none on a verdict or headline: explanatory prose

pre_registration: §9.28 committed b3ddccb13 (2026-10-30T19:01:45Z) before E30's code 0e4fccce1 (21:47:35Z) and records 22f560ff3/f8be1a0fe; its text at HEAD equals the registered text (one trailing blank line)
limitations: Accounting only: the audit re-prices products by 0, 1 or an F_p element; nothing is computed differently, so it is not an improvement of the index calculus (class fixed in §9.28).

The audit's window excludes set-up (precompute, base) and the [x]G check (G.5: those phases are 0.0008-0.04 % of S, so the audit can have missed at most that much; G2.111's band is unaffected); the walk audit's counter includes the walk's [d]G check while the walk cost excludes it, so the walk saving is an upper bound (it is <= 1.1 per walk either way).

The matched rho is E27's walk (iii) from E27's binary af2504ef1 (validated, research/e27_walk_20261030); E30's binary 0e4fccce1 reproduces E27's records leaf for leaf (G.1) and its walks' (ii) means exactly (G.3), and (iii) differs from (ii) only by the price of the recorded F_p inversions (E27 validation).
Operation counts only. The replay ran locally in the validator's 4-vCPU container, not on isolab-eks; no wall time is compared or claimed.
